name: k01-godown-date
prompt:
Noon inside a small distributor's godown in Nagpur: stacked plain kraft cartons with a sage-green band on steel racks, a shaft of daylight from the open shutter. The distributor (the man in his mid-fifties with a trimmed grey moustache, a light blue checked short-sleeved shirt, reading glasses pushed up on his head, a steel kada on his right wrist) stands close in the foreground holding one carton tilted up in both hands, reading the small plain white panel on its side with a concerned frown; a clipboard under his arm. Medium close shot, 50 mm, the carton and his face sharp, the racks soft behind.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. Every pack and carton is unbranded: plain kraft-brown cartons with a sage-green band, solid-colour snack packets (amber, green, red) with no lettering, Mango Drink as small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with no lettering. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no number plate anywhere. No children.
